component.name: P:EFII
component.summary: An unofficial native port of Star Trek: Elite Force II, based on the OpenMoHAA engine

description.p: ProvenanceEF2 is an unofficial project to bring Star Trek: Elite Force II to modern platforms by running its game content natively on the open-source OpenMoHAA engine (a descendant of the ioquake3 and F.A.K.K. lineage). It aims to play the original single-player campaign using the retail game assets.
